title: Ifosfamide
effect: Encephalopathy, sometimes fatal: confusion, somnolence, coma, hallucinations, extrapyramidal signs, seizures; onset hours to days after a dose and may recur (§5.2)
pearls: Boxed warning: encephalopathy (seizures are among its signs, §5.2)
Risk factors: high dose, hypoalbuminemia, renal impairment, poor performance status, bulky abdominal-pelvic disease, nephrotoxic drugs incl. cisplatin, CNS-active drugs, alcohol (§5.2)
Label: consider methylene blue for encephalopathy — no dose given (§5.2)
CYP3A4 inducers may increase chloroacetaldehyde, the neurotoxic metabolite — monitor for toxicity (§7.1)
Rechallenge after neurotoxicity: some recurred, including fatal events (§6.2)
sources: Ifex (ifosfamide) for injection US prescribing information. Baxter; revised 10/2026 (user-supplied label)
